'''Neeka Z'all''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I know her. Her parents escaped recently and left her here.|[[Gordo Zek]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FC" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Neeka Z'all was a child who lived on Corellia with her parents [[Zorgom Z'all|Zorgom]] and [[Norith Z'all]].<ref name="SWG:FC" /> At some point, Neeka and her family were captured by [[Faye Patrick]] who sold them to the [[Corellian slavers]].<ref name="SWG:TtB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Bandor|Corellia}}</ref> The Z'all family was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:FC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Zorgom and Norith managed to escape the bunker, along with a group of slaves led by [[Kyran Silene]]. Unfortunately, they lost Neeka in the escape and the girl was catch up. The escaped slaved did not reach Tyrena and established a camp in the wilderness. After her parents escaped, Neeka was removed from general population and put in a disciplinary cell.<ref name="SWG:FC" /> A spacer recruited by Kyran Silene's [[Madison Silene|wife]] later arrived at the camp of the escaped slaves.<ref name="SWG:TtB" /> The spacer planed to infiltrate the bunker to find evidence of the slaver operations for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:IE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Incriminating Evidence|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer also met Zorgom and Norith Z'all and agreed to rescue their daughter while going to the bunker. With the help of the slave [[Gordo Zek]], the spacer was able to find Neeka Z'all and helped her to escape the bunker. The child later returned to her parents.<ref name="SWG:FC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neeka Z'all was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Neeka Z'all was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
